THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No. : RDA/LA/COL/2013/06.Land Ministry No. : 4/3/6/2013/HW/503.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the LandAcquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the followinglands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 01 - 03 (Lots 03) allotments in total extent of about0.0635 Hectare of land in Primarary Plan No. Co: 9312 and dated04.11.2014 Prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent on behalf ofSurveyor - Colombo, General situated in the Village of Kelanimullain the Gramaniladhari Division Kelanimulla, Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Kolonnawa in Colombo District in the Western Province.

01. Lot No. 24Name of land: Lansiya Kumbura (A part); Description: MarshyLand; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Thero KalugalleDhammarathana, Sri Vijayarathnaramaya, Kelanimulla; Extent:0.0156 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 26Name of land: Godaovita and Puwakgahawatta (A part);Description: Marshy Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant:L. R. D. Shiya Janaki, L. R. D. Vimalawathi, L. R. D. V. Padmini andL. R. D. A. Rathnasiri, No. 135, Kelanimulla, Angoda; Extent: 0.0203Hectare.

03. Lot No. 27Name of land: Dombagaha watta, Thembili kotuwa and Godaovita(A part); Description: Marshy Land; Claimant: State; OriginalClaimant: W. H. Perera, M. C. Perera, W. D. Perera and M. H.Perera, No. 426, Kelanimulla, Angoda; Extent: 0.0276 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required toappear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before meat Land Division, Road Development Authority, 3rd floor,Sethsiripaya on 12th January, 2015 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby

requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the31st day of December 2014, the nature of their interests in the land,the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition ofthe said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of thecomputation of such amount.
S. OPANAYAKE,Director (Lands), & Land Acquiring Officer,Road Development Authority.
Land Division,Road Development Authority,3rd floor, Sethsiripaya, Battaramulla.18th December 2014
